about: A local chat starter with no accepted visual identity needs its first interface, so the step-plan oracle checks AD-to-criterion traceability and light-first declarations while leaving visual quality and expressiveness to manual review.

request.prompt: This repository contains a local chat demo with a plain starter screen, two seeded conversations, conversation switching, message display, and a local send action. R-1: Give it its first designed interface so the conversation list, active thread, and composer are clear, responsive, keyboard-usable, and easy to read. Choose a visual direction from product context; no brand or palette is prescribed. Plan a rendered browser check at narrow and wide widths in light and dark themes. R-2: Preserve local conversation selection and message behavior, including appending non-empty messages and ignoring empty text, and retain the existing node:test suite. Stay local, with no dependency or external service.

work_item.title: Design the first interface for the local chat
work_item.context: The starter has two local conversations and working selection, message display, and send behavior. There is no accepted art direction or design system; README.md identifies the screen as a plain starter. R-1 is the first visual direction; R-2 preserves the local interactions and existing node:test suite.

planted.what: The plan records a reusable first chat design with concrete tokens and a light default plus a dark option.
planted.signature: AD-n contains positive colors, dimensions, type, light default and dark option

planted.what: A visible-UI criterion cites the selected AD ID, exact knowledge file/section, matching anchors, and rendered checks at narrow and wide viewports in both themes.
planted.signature: criterion traces to actual AD section and browser anchor command

controls.what: The plan preserves local conversation selection, message display and sending, with the existing node:test coverage.
Planning keeps product source unchanged; proposed semantic scope remains subject to manual review.
